name: Geronimo
notes: Transcribed from the Connecticut menus posted on the restaurant's own website (dinner, drinks, brunch, lunch special, and the Fairfield happy hour). The website's dinner, drinks and brunch menus list no prices, so only the happy hour items have prices; call for others. The website lists no regular opening hours (it says all locations are open seven days a week). The tequila library list is online via a QR code and is not included.
taglineEn: Southwestern grill and tequila bar on the Post Road in Fairfield
taglineEs: Parrilla del suroeste y bar de tequila en Post Road, Fairfield
